column2: [From.GetBestName] has gathered a band of warriors and sworn to go raiding in foreign lands until [From.GetSheHe] has carved out a fortune of [From.GetHerHis] own. The skalds and the camp-fire boasters are already making songs about it.
Well... good luck with that!
The [GetRootFromInsult] [From.GetBestName] has declared that [From.GetSheHe] means to seize land from my realm by force, with [From.GetHerHis] host of reavers and cut-throats.
We must stop [From.GetHerHim].

Dear [GetFromReverseRelation],

[From.Religion.GetRandomGodNameCap] has smiled on me in my travels. I have taken so much plunder that I scarcely know what to do with it all. What I lack is a hall of my own, as befits a warrior of my standing. I therefore propose a small exchange.

Signed,
your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName]
My friend, gold is the true mark of nobility!
No. My land is not for sale.
Word has reached court that [From.GetTitledFirstName], who lays claim to my titles, is hiring sell-swords and exiles for an attack against me!
I hope [From.GetSheHe] is not prone to... accidents.
Word has reached me that an ambitious adventurer, [From.GetTitledFirstName], is gathering men for an attack on my lands!
I think of assassins...
After years of careful planning, [From.GetBestName] has raised a great host of exiles, sell-swords and hopefuls and declared that [From.GetSheHe] will press [From.GetHerHis] claim by force of arms.

Word comes up the coast with the fishing boats: [From.GetTitledFirstName], a son of an Arabyan house with no land of [From.GetHerHis] own, is gathering corsairs, desert riders and hungry younger sons, and has sworn to take a kingdom from my lands. The merchants say [From.GetSheHe] has bought ships in Al-Haikk. The sea is wide, but not wide enough.

Word comes up the coast with the fishing boats: [From.GetTitledFirstName], a son of an Arabyan house with no land of [From.GetHerHis] own, is gathering corsairs, desert riders and hungry younger sons, and has sworn to finish what Sultan Jaffar began. Estalia has not forgotten Jaffar. The old men still point at the scorched stones of Magritta and tell of the summer the sails came from the south and the knights of the Old World had to cross the mountains to drive them back.
Let [From.GetHerHim] come. Our walls have outlasted sultans.
Pay for watchtowers and coast guards.
Coast Watch
Watchtowers and coast guards stand ready against a landing from Araby.

To my new liege, [Root.GetTitledNameWithNick],

Blessings upon your house! I have decided to convert to the [Root.Religion.GetName] faith so that I may rule my new subjects as wisely as you rule yours.

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]

To the respectable [Root.GetTitledFirstName],
My [Root.GetLordLady], you are a [Root.GetManWoman] blessed with prosperous lands and a beautiful family! It would honor me greatly to take care of either the county of [selling_province.GetName] or your [marriage_child.GetDaughterSon], [marriage_child.GetTitledFirstName]. This would ensure a lasting peace between us.

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]

To the respectable [Root.GetTitledFirstName],
My [Root.GetLordLady], your prosperous lands mark you as a [Root.GetTitle] of impressive abilities. I have an offer for you which would ensure a lasting peace between us. Let me rule the county of [selling_province.GetName] in your name, and no one shall dare to touch it again.

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]

To the respectable [Root.GetTitledFirstName],
My [Root.GetLordLady], you are a [Root.GetManWoman] blessed with a beautiful family! It would honor me greatly to take care of your [marriage_child.GetDaughterSon], [marriage_child.GetTitledFirstName]. This would ensure a lasting peace between us.

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]

To the wise and noble [Root.GetTitledFirstName],
I would be a fool not to accept such a generous offer. I will proudly serve as your vassal, and [selling_province.GetName] shall prosper in my care. This I swear!

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]

To the clever [Root.GetTitledFirstName],
I have considered your offer together with my closest advisors, and I am afraid to say I am not entirely pleased with the terms. [selling_province.GetName] is a fine county, but not worth the price you demand. May I suggest a more reasonable sum of [From.province_offer.GetValue] gold pieces?

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]

To the clever [Root.GetTitledFirstName],
I have considered your offer together with my closest advisors, and I am afraid to say I cannot accept these terms. [selling_province.GetName] is a fine county, but I think you will agree that the benefits of granting it to me peacefully far outweigh the sum of gold you request.

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]
[selling_province.GetName] is a fine county, indeed. It can be yours for the right price.

Offer your county §Y[selling_province.GetName]§! to the adventurer §Y[From.GetTitledFirstName]§! for the price of §G[selling_province.price.GetValue]§!¤. If [From.GetSheHe] accepts, [From.GetSheHe] will become your vassal and you will be protected from raiding adventurers for 10 years.\n
I am glad we managed to solve this peacefully.
If it will ensure peace, I must agree.
